title: Cell-level Balanced Three-Statement PFM Blueprint
boundary: 演示数据 · 非真实项目 · 不可用于决策
design_position: Synthetic values are populated. Every managed model cell is classified as value or formula and carries its sheet address, cached value, number format and upstream references.

workbook_contract.cell_registry_policy: Every non-empty cell in the complete workbook, including the 14 source/calculation sheets and the README, generated Lineage and Audit_Log support sheets.

modules.label: 来源与映射
modules.purpose: 原始月度财务数据 → canonical line mapping → 历史聚合。

modules.label: Drivers 与 Opex
modules.purpose: 收入增速、毛利率、四类 Opex 比率、税率及融资参数。

modules.label: Working Capital
modules.purpose: DSO / DIO / DPO → AR / Inventory / AP → CFO。

modules.label: PPE Roll-forward
modules.purpose: Opening PPE + Capex − D&A = Closing PPE。

modules.label: Debt Sweep
modules.purpose: Requested / effective repayment、facility cap、cash floor 与利息。

modules.label: 三表与控制
modules.purpose: 月度三表内生联动、现金滚存、税项与配平检查。

drivers.basis: Explicit assumption applied to prior-year revenue; monthly allocation uses derived historical seasonality.

drivers.label: 毛利率
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by 24-month synthetic history.

drivers.label: 销售费用率
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by historical ratio.

drivers.label: 管理费用率
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by historical ratio.

drivers.label: 研发费用率
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by historical ratio.

drivers.label: 其他 Opex 比率
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by historical ratio.

drivers.label: DSO
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by latest-12-month synthetic DSO.

drivers.label: DIO
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by latest-12-month synthetic DIO.

drivers.label: DPO
drivers.basis: Explicit assumption informed by latest-12-month synthetic DPO.

drivers.label: 年度还款申请
drivers.basis: Requested repayment; schedule separately shows effective and excess amounts.

drivers.label: 借款利率
drivers.basis: Interest on monthly opening debt; no cash-sweep circularity.

drivers.label: 最低现金
drivers.basis: Explicit liquidity floor used only to size the labeled facility draw.

drivers.label: 融资额度
drivers.basis: Facility draw is capped by closing debt not exceeding this amount.

drivers.label: PPE 剩余折旧期
drivers.basis: Monthly straight-line proxy on opening net PPE plus half-period capex.

drivers.label: 税款支付滞后
drivers.basis: Cash tax equals prior-month tax payable.

formula_lineages.label: Revenue → Profit → Cash
formula_lineages.summary: 收入假设经月度季节性分配进入 P&L，再通过净利润与营运资金进入 CFO。

formula_lineages.label: Opex Build-up
formula_lineages.summary: 销售、管理、研发及其他 Opex 比率分别驱动费用，不用单一总费用率黑箱。

formula_lineages.label: DSO / DIO / DPO → CFO
formula_lineages.summary: 周转天数驱动 AR、Inventory、AP，余额变化逐项桥接至经营现金流。

formula_lineages.label: PPE Roll-forward
formula_lineages.summary: 期初 PPE、Capex、折旧和期末 PPE 使用同一月度 state equation。

formula_lineages.label: Debt Sweep / Facility Draw
formula_lineages.summary: 还款申请先变成有效还款；现金低于 floor 时，在 facility cap 内明确提款。

formula_lineages.label: 三表闭环与配平
formula_lineages.summary: P&L 净利润、CFS 现金滚存、BS 现金与 retained earnings 在月度闭环中同步。
